text:
hana-marketing: Quick thread  pruning idea for the post-launch nurture drip + subject-line A/B. We had noisy sends last time. Thoughts?
omar-growth: Yea, saw uptick in unsub when launch email + benchmark + webinar invite were all in 8 days. Need smarter suppression.
lin-analytics: Numbers: overlap rate ~10% for paid_new; unsub spike +1.8pp. SQL I used is in the doc.
mike-campaigns: Proposed pruning logic: 1) If user opened any email in last 48h -> delay next marketing send 5 days. 2) If user triggered "first_success" event -> move to onboarding-only flow. 3) For paid_new, move benchmark to D9 instead of D5.
julia-sales: Also: skip webinar invite if sales_contacted=true. We should prefer a 1:1 nudge.
omh: (typo) ignore
omar-growth: A/B test for subject line: Variant A (benchmark: "See how your peers spend less on inference"), Variant B ("Benchmark: real infra cost wins we measured"). Randomize 50/50 within paid_new cohort, N>=5k each. Measure open -> register rate.
mike-campaigns: I'll update Braze flow and add suppression list name "prune_recently_engaged". Will stage and dry-send to test list.
lin-analytics: I'll export cohorts and the suppression CSV today. Also will track downstream demo conversions for 14 days.
hana-marketing: Owner list: Mike (flows + staging), Lin (cohorts + metrics), Omar (test design), Julia (sales flag check). Target deploy next Wed. Thanks :thumbsup:
